retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: a raid on the Tabaqueira works by the PRP-BR on 31 January 1980. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.

title: Assault on Tabaqueira, by the PRP-BR, on January 31, 1980
summary: Wikidata item Q115691683, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "robbery carried out by 5 members of the PRP-BR, with 2,100,000$00 stolen, destined to pay the salaries of part of its 1000 employees". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
